seeded_from: Retrofit on 2026-08-11. Villain clocks and threads are estimates built from the existing Pacing & Pressure Timers table in dm_story.md and from session_log.md. Formal clock/thread tracking (Operating Guide Section 2-4) starts at session 3. The dm_story.md row 'Thieves' Guild notices new player in town' is not carried into a thread here: its trigger (Sireth uses thieves' tools visibly) has not happened yet. It stays tracked only in dm_story.md until it triggers, then must be added here.

villains.name: Commander Voss
villains.goal: Keep the Flaming Fist protection racket with the slave-trade pipeline running, and silence anyone who can prove it.
villains.trait: Former war hero who rationalizes the racket as controlling chaos, not causing it.

clocks.name: Silence the leak
clocks.description: Find and neutralize Cassara Whitmore before she can act on her copy of the assassination contract.

clocks.name: Discover the contract was copied
clocks.description: Voss learns that Cassara copied the assassination contract before House Maren's people find her first.

villains.name: Councillor Duvane
villains.goal: Stay hidden inside the compromised Council, survive Voss's suspicion, and keep his own position.
villains.trait: Exhausted, not gleeful, about his own corruption — believes the system is too broken to fix from outside.

clocks.name: Neutralize Cassara and Sireth quietly
clocks.description: Triggers only if the party pursues the legal path (Council Hall archives, magistrates). Duvane moves to quietly remove both threats before they reach the Council floor.

villains.name: House Maren
villains.goal: Keep the Underdark-to-Amn slave pipeline running undetected behind a public reputation for charity.
villains.trait: Publicly the most charitable merchant house in the city.

threads.description: Main quest: prove the Voss/Harwin/Duvane conspiracy and expose the slave-trade pipeline.

Sister Gareth at the Dock Ward chapel has independent evidence; unconfirmed Harper connection. If the party earns her trust, a Harper contact reaches out the session after this meeting (dm_story.md pressure timer).
Council Hall archives could verify the contract signatures — the legal-path alternative to Sister Gareth.
Cassara secretly made a second copy of the assassination contract. She has not told Sireth.

facts.fact: Aldus Thorne was murdered by Flaming Fist assassins six weeks before the campaign start, disguised as a robbery.
The assassination contract was signed for 500 gold pieces and bears the signatures of Commander Voss and Captain Harwin.
Cassara Whitmore is a former Council scribe hiding from the Flaming Fist.
Sister Gareth is present at the Chapel of Ilmater in Dock Ward and recognized Sireth on sight.

characters.name: Sireth
characters.notes: HP 9/9 as of end of session 2.

promises.promise: Sireth will investigate the Flaming Fist corruption in exchange for payment and information.

rulings.ruling: DC 14 Insight check required to tell whether Cassara is hiding something specific beyond her general fear.
rulings.context: Session 2 negotiation scene with Cassara Whitmore.
